description:
Legacy music scheduling software, succeeded by Myriad Schedule

Myriad AutoTrack SE v4.6 is the music scheduling application that has been succeeded by Myriad Schedule, which is included with Myriad Playout. It is no longer in active development.
v4.6.3 (Release 2) 2nd April 2024
New Features/Changes:
Clock Editor:
- AI Voice Links: The Voice Link Script editor has been dramatically improved and you now edit the Clock Item via a dedicated Edit Voice Link window that allows you to enter much longer scripts as well as being able to select the voice you want to use from your Station's selector voice provider.
- AI Voice Links: Dragging a new voice link item in from the treeview now sets the Clock Item to have a swept ending by default. If you are adding rows manually and selecting the row type by using the dropdown menu then you just need to scroll to the right and double click the Ending Type column to change it.
